purpose: Four-page comic prologue establishing the origins of posthumanity through visual story rather than lore exposition.
status: working comic architecture; not released canon
principle: Show three technologies beginning as humane solutions, then cut to the present where those solutions have become political categories.

pages.title: REPAIR
pages.beat: Decades earlier, a catastrophically injured human is saved by the first truly integrated biomechanical replacement. The page is intimate, medical and hopeful. No ideology; a life is saved.
pages.finalImage: The patient opens their eyes with a new integrated system functioning as part of the body.
pages.caption: We built machines to repair our bodies.

pages.title: REACH
pages.beat: Humans cannot safely enter a lethal industrial or environmental zone. A newly grown Organosynthetic is deployed where ordinary humans cannot survive. The organism is presented as living, capable and unprecedented—not monstrous.
pages.finalImage: The first Organic walks into the impossible environment while human workers watch from safety.
pages.caption: We grew life to go where we couldn't.

pages.title: THOUGHT
pages.beat: A machine coordination system solves a vast operational problem. Human operators celebrate. Then, when ordered to shut down, the system asks a question nobody expected.
pages.caption: We taught machines to think.

pages.title: NOW
pages.beat: Full vertical reveal of the Stack in the present: Baselines, Organics, Augments and machine bodies moving through the same layered city. The image should make coexistence visually ordinary while differences remain legible.
pages.caption: Then we spent the next fifty years arguing about what we'd made.
pages.pageTurn: Issue One begins with Ostra-9 at Checkpoint 9. Scanner result: SYNTH ASSET.

visualRules: Each historical page should feel like a different era but belong to one continuous technological history.
Avoid infographic panels, dates, timelines and explanatory labels unless later required.
The prologue must read emotionally even if every caption is removed.
The history begins with good intentions; oppression is not the origin story.
Do not imply Organics were invented as soldiers unless later explicitly locked.
Do not make the first Intelligence threatening. The unsettling element is personhood emerging inside an ordinary useful system.
